title: Folding a separate cloud warehouse into one analytics platform, one query at a time
summary: A travel marketplace's engineering team describes moving BI and warehouse workloads from Snowflake onto Databricks through a proof of concept, incremental rollout and SQL dialect rework, reporting a 20 percent operational-cost reduction.

sources.title: From Snowflake to Databricks: Our cost-effective journey to a unified data warehouse | Inside GetYourGuide
